justification: Changes the rule text every property page shows for council DCP rules (16,520 of 19,627 now show the council's copied words), their page links, and whether the DCP number chip runs. Wrong, a reader would see words or a page that are not the council's.

pre_impl.existing_data: regulatory_provisions.council_quote, quote_page, quote_status (migration 111, filled 2026-10-12 for all 19,627 served council DCP rules)
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: A row with status exact/recovered but no stored quote: servedQuoteStatus sends null, so the extracted text is shown with the 'not yet checked' note and no number chip (the migration 111 CHECK constraint already forbids such a row).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to every served row on read; nothing is written. A rule whose text changes later loses its quote by trigger (migrations 111-112) and falls back to the note.
pre_impl.external_source_error: No external source: the quote columns are in the same row the route already selects. A DB error fails the route as before.
pre_impl.frontend_type: Provision interface in PageGroupedProvisions.tsx gains quote_status, quote_page, source_council; PageFields in lib/page-citation.ts gains quote_status, quote_page.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: If the swap failed, the reader sees the extracted text exactly as before, but every council rule carries 'Not yet checked against the council's PDF' -- visible, not silent.

functions.name: shownText
functions.input: one served rule row carrying provision_text, council_quote and quote_status from the database
functions.output: the council's words alone with printed line breaks, else the extracted text
functions.if_none: null provision_text and no quote returns an empty string; renderers already handle empty text

functions.name: servedQuoteStatus
functions.input: one served rule row's quote_status and council_quote columns as read from the database
functions.output: status string sent to the client, or null when hollow
functions.if_none: null status stays null, so the rule shows the not-yet-checked note

functions.name: withCouncilWords
functions.input: each database row returned by the two PROVISION_BASE_SELECT queries in this route
functions.output: response row with swapped text and normalised status, quote not sent twice
functions.if_none: missing columns read as undefined and fall back to extracted text

values.if_missing: rule shows extracted text with 'Not yet checked against the council's PDF' and no number chip

queries.purpose: select a property's DCP rules with their quote columns
queries.where_clause: unchanged: existing layer filters (council, chapter, zone, dev type, is_current, v2_is_actionable)
queries.if_wrong: the quote travels with its own row; a rule cannot show another rule's words

break_it.scenario: A row claims exact/recovered but its stored quote is empty
break_it.what_happens: the client would label extracted text as the council's wording
break_it.how: council-quote.ts servedQuoteStatus nulls the status server side; migration 111 CHECK forbids the row

break_it.scenario: The DCP number chip reads a number from a rule the program could not confirm
break_it.what_happens: a limit the council never printed is shown beside the rule
break_it.how: PageGroupedProvisions.tsx numeric chip returns null unless numbersUsable

break_it.scenario: The council's words sit on a different page than the stored page (713 rules)
break_it.what_happens: the link would open a page that does not hold the words shown
break_it.how: page-citation.ts anchors quote_page when the rule shows council words

break_it.scenario: PDF lines of the council's text are joined for reading
break_it.what_happens: a hyphenated word or a table row would be altered while labelled as the council's wording
break_it.how: council-quote.ts keeps every printed line break; only a bare label line joins its text

break_it.scenario: The query returns the wrong rows or the quote columns are missing
break_it.what_happens: rules show without the council's words or with another rule's text
break_it.how: quote columns come from the same row (route.ts:766); missing columns fall back to extracted text with the note

break_it.scenario: Our generated heading line is shown above the council's words
break_it.what_happens: text the council never printed would sit under a note saying the wording is the council's
break_it.how: shownText returns only the council's words when they are stored

break_it.scenario: A rule checked as unmatched or as map text is labelled 'not yet checked'
break_it.what_happens: the note would misstate what the check found for that council rule
break_it.how: quoteNote returns one note per copier verdict
break_it.repro: npx jest __tests__/lib/council-quote.test.ts -t 'says what the check found'

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a recovered rule shows the reader's rewording (NB 130236), an unchecked council rule feeds the number chip or loses its note, or a confirmed rule links a page other than its quote page
falsifiable_check.observed_red: The first version dropped council_quote from the payload while the client still required it, so every council rule would have read 'not yet checked'; caught in review before tests ran, fixed with servedQuoteStatus and the 'hollow' test.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Production 2026-10-12: served council DCP rules by quote_status = exact 15,095 / recovered 1,425 / not_a_control 27 / unconfirmed 3,080.

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: open a property with Waverley and Northern Beaches rules on the preview and check the note and page links
